node: Indium phosphide, III-V photonics, lasers, photodetectors, and silicon-photonics integration
summary: This pass expands the photonics-capacity node from the obvious InP leaders into the adjacent chokepoints that AI optics actually depend on: outsourced optical packaging/test and early silicon-photonics integration. Coherent and Lumentum are the direct reference anchors. Fabrinet is the more obscure second-order manufacturing/packaging beneficiary. Aeluma is a speculative shadow candidate that maps to the same constraint but remains commercialization-risky. The key hidden dependency is that AI bandwidth scaling can be limited not only by optical demand, but by InP wafer/device capacity, packaging throughput, and the ability to integrate compound semiconductors onto silicon at scale.
